title: Flow Graph Navbar Toggle Theming
description: Flow nodes/handles/edges must match navbar toggle theming: element gray default, hover fill + emphasized content, selected primary fill + emphasized stroke/text.
summary: Fixed computation channel row hover/selection fill not reaching node edges: input_port_row_hit_bounds and output_port_row_hit_bounds now use computation_channel_row_divider_x_span (node edge ↔ center divider) instead of narrow label-column bounds, so paint_computation_channel_row_highlights and channel-row picking share full-row width. Moved ComputationChannelRowSide enum earlier; updated/extended tests for full-span bounds and detail LOD hover probes.
